name: luma-manager-email-to-table

deploy.description: Luma email making Dennis a manager of an event ("Please join me as a host for ..." or "... is live on Luma") -> record the evt- id from its manage link in the Luma Managed Events Table -> if the event is on the Notion Singapore calendar, backfill it: fire luma-hosted-event-to-notion with the event, then luma-hosted-guest-to-event-attendance once per non-invited guest, since the polling triggers already delivered (and skipped) them before Dennis was a manager.

params.query: from:luma-mail.com subject:("Please join me as a host for" OR "is live on Luma")

trigger.authentication_note: Gmail dennis@work.flowers (the non-shared connection, same as gmail-attachments-to-drive-by-type and zapier-error-email-to-triage).
trigger.trigger_note: Polling 'New Email Matching Search', one run per email. The query only narrows the poll; parseManagerEmail() makes the authoritative sender/subject checks and throws if a manager-shaped email has no evt- link (Luma changed the email).

connections_note: luma_notionsg is used for the integration's two triggers called as READ actions (new_event, new_or_updated_guest with event_ids), which is how the backfill lists one event and its guests. listWorkflows/triggerWorkflow use the durable's ambient account credentials; no connection.
version_pinning_note: @zapier/zapier-durable 0.14.1 (2026-09-29) and @zapier/zapier-sdk 0.115.1 (2026-10-06) were the newest releases at least 24h old at build time. No zod: nothing imports it.

managed_events.name: Luma Managed Events
managed_events.role: Written here, one row per evt- id, idempotent. Backfill Status: pending -> `done: N guests fired, M invited skipped` or `not-on-calendar` (an event on another Luma calendar the key cannot see).

rows: evt-WCXl3pOH3lRap1F (Notion Build Bar Singapore, host invite of 2026-10-08), Backfill Status `pending`
seeded.why: Its email predates this Zap. Run the backfill once after merge: `trigger-workflow` this Zap with that Gmail message as input (README, 'After merge').
